postal_system.assignment_rule: SVG Post's current public reference page lists 58 distinct VC-prefixed six-character codes under Kingstown, Windward, Leeward and Grenadines. The table includes post-box and general-delivery entries alongside locality labels. A syntax match, region prefix or label is not a stable current row ID, validity interval, complete history, geographic footprint, address or building relation.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Keep post box, general delivery, post office, locality, limited home-delivery context and any future area object independently typed. A VCNNNN code can route through a post office or non-area delivery object and must not be forced into Polygon geometry.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No authority-published versioned reusable postal Polygon/MultiPolygon release was identified. Census Divisions, parishes, islands, localities, post-office points, routes, address points, buildings, buffers, hulls, interpolation, Voronoi/raster cells and AGID cells are prohibited proxies.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Normalize VC followed by four digits and place it on a separate line below locality. Store recipient, organization, premises, thoroughfare, locality, administrative context, post office and post box independently; the postcode does not authorize an exact address or building relation.
postal_system.id_rule: Future results must keep postal_object_id, postal_object_type, administrative_context_id, geometry_id, source_assertion_id, release_id, civic_address_id, building_id and agid_crosswalk_id separate. Unknown or unlicensed links remain null with an explicit reason.
postal_system.building_rule: Building-level display requires a separately rights-cleared stable civic-address identity, an explicit reviewed relation to a permitted building identifier and permitted point or footprint geometry. Postcode containment, label equality or proximity is not that relation.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent versioned spatial index. A future crosswalk may link source-qualified postal, administrative, civic-address and building IDs without relabelling AGID or Census Division geometry as SVG Post geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The Statistical Office open licence applies to its own data with attribution and third-party exclusions. It does not license SVG Post or UPU assignment data and does not change census geography into postal authority. Public SVG Post and UPU reference access supplies no blanket processing, derivation, redistribution or public-serving grant for a complete postcode database or postal geometry.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Public pages and assignments can change. Store retrieval time, edition, observed_at, valid_from, valid_to, alias, correction, exception, byte length and SHA-256 independently; never overwrite historical evidence.

stages.definition: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines address-format and source inventory only.
Digest-bound SVG Post, UPU and Statistical Office format, assignment-count, mixed postal-object, rights, census-versus-postal, address-format, ID-separation and no-proxy evidence.

M2 requires a current authoritative SVG Post or competent-public immutable release containing a complete finite national denominator with stable postal object IDs, every VCNNNN assignment, object type, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit area/non-area status, fixed with retrieval time, edition, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The current SVG Post page exposes 58 distinct labels and codes, while the UPU sheet documents post-office, P.O.-box, rural and very limited home-delivery semantics; neither supplies a versioned complete typed release, compatible dataset rights or postal geometry. Every drawable code must reconcile to a fixed real Polygon/MultiPolygon whose postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions are explicit. Census Divisions, parishes, islands, localities, post offices, routes, addresses, buildings, Points, buffers, hulls, interpolation, Voronoi/raster cells and AGID cells are prohibited proxies. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real VC API/app, normalize VC plus four digits, handle loading/no-match/multiple/API-failure/invalid-geometry/non-area states, fit and render translucent fill with a clear outline only for eligible real geometry, support clear/re-search and display selected code, postal object type, geometry kind, provenance class, source, reference date, confidence and separate postal, administrative, geometry, assertion, release, civic-address, building and AGID crosswalk IDs without inferring missing relations.

agid_integration.current_scope: VC address, normalization and source metadata only; no real VC Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A current complete typed assignment denominator, compatible rights, immutable assignment and eligible geometry artifacts, and actual VC loader/API/app verification are required.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Never manufacture a VC postal polygon or more-detailed address/building ID from Census Divisions, parishes, islands, localities, service points, routes, coordinates or AGID cells.
